content.text:
This is an overhead photo of one plate of food from a cafeteria.
List every visible food on the plate, at most 20 items. For each item, estimate its weight in grams and its food energy in kilocalories (kcal).
Reply with only one JSON object in exactly this shape, and nothing else:
{"items": [{"name": "<food name>", "grams": <number>, "kcal": <number>}]}
Use an empty list if no food is visible.

{"items": [{"name": "spinach salad leaves", "grams": 60, "kcal": 14}, {"name": "grilled chicken pieces", "grams": 110, "kcal": 190}, {"name": "shredded carrot", "grams": 10, "kcal": 4}, {"name": "corn kernels", "grams": 10, "kcal": 9}, {"name": "coleslaw cabbage", "grams": 25, "kcal": 8}, {"name": "arugula leaves", "grams": 10, "kcal": 3}, {"name": "breaded fish or chicken piece", "grams": 50, "kcal": 120}, {"name": "dried cranberries", "grams": 8, "kcal": 25}, {"name": "sunflower or seed topping", "grams": 3, "kcal": 17}]}
